view.summary: Naytiba Raid: fight five Naytiba bosses one-on-one as EVE, using parries, dodges and skills, and upgrade her between fights. Plus the Can Shelf: collect drink cans on the event field.

overview.title: Naytiba Raid
items: Bring the boss’s HP to 0 before the timer runs out; EVE then executes it. Your score comes from damage dealt and time left.
Tap to attack (combo), swipe to dodge, Guard button to block, Tumbler button to heal. Burst and Beta skills use their gauges.
Guard at the right moment: no damage, the boss loses balance, and EVE gains 25 Beta Energy.
Dodge at the right moment: EVE gains 75 Burst Energy (gauge max 400).
Signalled by a coloured flash and cannot be guarded: dodge them, or counter Blue with Blink and Purple with Repulse.
Both sides have a shield gauge; once it is empty, hits do more damage. Emptying a boss’s balance gauge makes it groggy, open to Retribution.
EVE dies at 0 HP or when time runs out.
Your best score on each Challenge stage is added up for the Union ranking.

overview.title: Currencies
rows: Used to purchase gear in the Shop or to enhance characters.
Used as a material for enhancing max HP.
Used as a material for enhancing Max Beta Energy.

overview.title: Can Shelf
items: A separate collection: 20 drink cans are hidden on the event field. See the Can Shelf page.
